meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 多了一个 Emacs 渠道:你可以在 Emacs 里打开聊天缓冲区直接提问,也可以把 org 文件的标题或选区发给它,回复会作为子标题插回原处。
howto.when: 当你在 Emacs 中按快捷键打开聊天缓冲区(如 C-c n c),或对 org 文件的标题/选区执行发送命令时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看这个函数的报错,怎么改?
say.note: 回复会显示在聊天缓冲区。

say.text: 把这一段会议记录整理成行动项列表
say.note: 发送当前 org 子树,回复作为子标题插入。

say.text: 帮我把这段文字改写得更正式
say.note: 选中区域发送,在原处获得改后文本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes available from Emacs: you can ask questions in an interactive chat buffer, or send an org heading or region; answers are inserted back as child headings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you open the Emacs chat buffer (e.g. C-c n c / SPC N c) or run the org-send command on a heading or selected region.

say_en.text: Help me fix the error in this function.
say_en.note: Reply appears in the chat buffer.

say_en.text: Turn this meeting note into an action-item list.
say_en.note: Sends the current org subtree; reply becomes a child heading.

say_en.text: Rewrite this text in a more formal tone.
say_en.note: Selected region is sent; revised text appears in place.
